say:1:1330207001:1.text: I can tell from the buzz. It's the liveliest day of the year in Cedartown.
say:1:1330207001:1.source_cn: 听着这声音就知道，雪松镇每年也就这个时候最热闹。
say:1:1330207001:1.male: I can tell from the buzz. It's the liveliest day of the year in Cedartown.
say:1:1330207001:1.female: I can tell from the buzz. It's the liveliest day of the year in Cedartown.

say:2:1330207002:1.text: As someone who grew up in this town, I've attended the festival countless times.
say:2:1330207002:1.source_cn: 我从小在镇子里长大，已经参加了太多次祭典。
say:2:1330207002:1.male: As someone who grew up in this town, I've attended the festival countless times.
say:2:1330207002:1.female: As someone who grew up in this town, I've attended the festival countless times.

say:3:1330207003:1.text: I've had enough of the hubbub. Now, I prefer to relax somewhere quiet.
say:3:1330207003:1.source_cn: 我已经凑够了热闹，现在的我只想躲在安静的地方。
say:3:1330207003:1.male: I've had enough of the hubbub. Now, I prefer to relax somewhere quiet.
say:3:1330207003:1.female: I've had enough of the hubbub. Now, I prefer to relax somewhere quiet.
